notes: Hand-authored, not derived. Rule: the file holding the checks that reject an invitation link. acceptInvitation() in src/server/services/invitation-service.ts is the only place the three refusals live — revoked (revokedAt), already used (acceptedAt) and past its date (expiresAt) — and DEFAULT_EXPIRY_DAYS, which sets that date, is declared in the same file. EXCLUDED: src/server/repositories/invitation-repository.ts (findInvitationByTokenHash returns the row on token hash alone and applies none of the three predicates); src/app/(auth)/invite/[token]/page.tsx and invite-accept-form.tsx (render the outcome); src/actions/members/accept-invitation.ts (Server Action wrapper with no validity logic); src/schemas/invitation.ts (shape of the token input only).
